hook_text: R10 160 for one tank of petrol? Your brain can catch that in two seconds.
clip_script: Estimate the fuel bill: 42,6 litres times R23,85. Round 42,6 to forty and 23,85 to twenty-five, because forty times twenty-five is easy: one thousand. An answer of R10 160,10 for less than fifty litres of fuel at about twenty-four rand is plainly impossible.
visual_style: A fuel pump display spins to R10 160,10 then flashes red; the numbers round to 40 and 25; the display corrects to R1 016,01 in green.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson for three ways to check any decimal answer.
